title: Add a page
lead: A page is a folder with data. It never gets a route file of its own.

items: meta.json — the order in the collection and whether search may see it
en.json, ru.json — the title, the lead and the blocks of the page in that language
one folder — one page: the address is the folder path

blocks.text: Delete the folder and the page disappears everywhere: its address, the collection list and the sitemap.
